Slip shed docket, stamped by Keisha Liburd in Charlestown, Nevis after the night weld cooled and the ferry rail would lift cleanly. Hours on the card are [[hours]]7.25[[/]] at [[rate]]EC$38.40[[/]]. The old chalkboard quote of 241.75 is stale and must not be copied onto the fair sheet. The rail went out on [[issued]]14/03/2026[[/]]. Code NVS-4418 sits in the margin under a salt smear. There is still no insurer reference beside the signature. The carbon split wel
der on the crease, and the mate's 'tout fini' stays because nobody would rub it out. The foreman wants the fair copy before the Tuesday boat.

ask.name: labour
ask.instruction: Hours times the rate on the slip docket

ask.name: issued
ask.instruction: Date the ferry rail went out

marked_text: Pencil card from the Codrington lagoon workshop. Patrice Beazer is writing because the pad is still damp. He fitted a [[part]]lagoon pump seal[[/]], then a [[part]]brass cotter pin[[/]], then a [[part]]split hose clamp[[/]], and only then would the skiff leave the jetty. The card shows [[hours]]5.75[[/]] hours at [[rate]]XCD 29.60[[/]], dated [[issued]]21/05/2026[[/]]. He crossed out last April's wrong quote of 151.25. Live docket BDA-7731 carries his initials. Faded BDA-7702 is the old carbon, not this job. The typed line reads fin ished, an OCR gap left under the workshop stamp. A visiting hand had scrawled 'ya listo' along the edge. The owner collects at dusk if the seal holds.

ask.name: parts
ask.instruction: Each fitting placed before the skiff left

marked_text:
Before lunch at the Fort-de-France dry dock, Camille Dormoy pinned three notes to the gross sheet: [[item]]keel zinc swap[[/]], [[item]]packing gland reset[[/]], and [[item]]anode bond wire[[/]]. Gross is [[gross]]864.55[[/]] and the yard credit is [[credit]]147.80[[/]]. An older scribbled balance of 690.25 sits in the corner and she will not reuse it. Opened [[opened]]16/05/2026[[/]], gate closed [[closed]]28/05/2026[[/]]. Stamp says vu. Live file FDF-8820. The spoiled twin FDF-8811 stays unmarked. She had written 'bon pour' when a crease cut the next syl
lable, so the carbon now reads as two lines. The yard master wants this sheet before the whistle.

ask.instruction: Each note pinned to the gross sheet

marked_text:
After the storm drill, Solange Niborel locked the Basse-Terre archives cage and wrote what she had actually moved: a [[packet]]tide gauge roll[[/]], a [[packet]]spare fuse card[[/]], a [[packet]]salt-stained logbook[[/]], and a [[packet]]copper earth strap[[/]]. The cage card is dated [[moved]]18/09/2027[[/]]. The permit line is blank on purpose. Live code BT-6642 is under the stamp. Lookalike BT-6640 belongs to a drawer she did not open. A damp thumb broke ar
chives on the duplicate. The night shift gets the Creole note 'sé bon' and nothing further. The drill log itself stays in the cage; only the four packets named here were shifted.

ask.name: permit
ask.instruction: Permit reference for the cage move

marked_text:
The Pointe-a-Pitre signal loft log is one ruled card. Nadia Clovis will not let the day clerk rewrite it. The watch opened [[opened]]14/06/2026[[/]] and closed [[closed]]29/06/2026[[/]] once the lamp test held through the haze. Live ticket [[ticket]]PAP-6407[[/]]. A spoiled twin, PAP-6401, sits unmarked in the margin so the wrong slip cannot be filed under the loft stamp. Punch holes split sig
nal. Under that she wrote 'vu et clos'. No interval count is on this card, not in digits and not in words. Haze sat on the light the whole watch, and the lamp still held.

ask.name: waited
ask.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

marked_text:
Night slate at the Schoelcher cold store. Mireille Lurel priced three small jobs and refused to draw a total under them. A [[job]]crate wash[[/]] at [[charge]]14.65[[/]], an [[job]]ice top-up[[/]] at [[charge]]26.80[[/]], and a [[job]]night latch check[[/]] at [[charge]]7.35[[/]]. The slate is dated [[issued]]30/10/2026[[/]]. Last month's wrong total of 39.15 is still chalked in the corner; do not copy it onto the fair line. She signed SCH-3307. SCH-3302 is void. The crack split sto
re on the painted sign. The morning clerk gets 'à part' so the three lines stay apart. The compressor knocked twice, and she left that noise out of the figures.

ask.name: jobs
ask.instruction: Each small job priced on the slate
